full_judgment: 9. He farther submits that Gyanda Sundari executed 3 sale deeds in the year of 1972 from which it is presumed that at that time she was in Bangladesh, as such burden of proof was upon the Government that at that time she was not present in this county but the Government failed to prove that fact. The Government admitting title of the plaintiffs received rent from them, as such, Government is barred by principle of estoppel.
